CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2445 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 40c4e1194dfd23371403f874e9a8a1abd45da162. Bus nonce: ca38930611db40cea073c44a6e7cdd8d. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly; this round's reviewer measures with the finder's harness. Earlier rounds' verdicts are the PR's `Fix review:` comments: say which round this is. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 40c4e1194dfd23371403f874e9a8a1abd45da162`; the PR body is in the PR. This is production code (setpoint/power solver start). Rule explicitly on two points in the verdict: (1) the flat-price null control was weakened from plan identity to "never worse, and every flat-price move lowers the objective"; the orchestrator accepted that under mandate 6175172275 (carried to R10-STAMP, roster 7b87e23ed). Confirm the data supports it (census: 20/32 flat cells move, all lower) or block. (2) The Raspberry Pi CPU cost is only estimated (+8 to +16 s per clamped solve, from +2.0-2.7 s measured on arm64); judge whether that is acceptable for merge with a post-release Pi measurement, or whether a maxiter cap is owed now. The features checks were re-cut for x86_64 solver basins; CI fast (3.14) on Linux at this head is the real test, so read it. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: <merge|blocked> 40c4e1194dfd23371403f874e9a8a1abd45da162` for merge, or `Fix review: blocked 40c4e1194dfd23371403f874e9a8a1abd45da162 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets) for blocked, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: ca38930611db40cea073c44a6e7cdd8d`. Put the evidence in an `ev/` directory beside it, including `ev/HEAD` holding the 40-hex head you measured, under /tmp/seat/rev2445/. Do NOT run bus.sh: the dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, and the orchestrator publishes the verdict there. Return it on a probe ref, and push nothing else: `cd /tmp/seat/rev2445 && rm -rf pr && git init -q pr && cp -r verdict.md ev pr/ && git -C pr add -A && git -C pr -c user.name=hpo-seat -c user.email=hpo-seat@users.noreply.github.com commit -qm "verdict 2445 40c4e1194dfd23371403f874e9a8a1abd45da162" && git -C /home/user/heatpump_optimizer fetch -q /tmp/seat/rev2445/pr HEAD && git -C /home/user/heatpump_optimizer push -q origin FETCH_HEAD:refs/heads/probe/rev-2445-ca389306`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except that probe ref. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in the verdict instead.
